policy: six distinct combat units per faction; 10 distinct economy workers and two summons; legacy palette rosters retired with stable-ID migration

units.name: 镇印刀盾卫
units.design: Broad square red lamellar infantry, huge rectangular seal shield and short heavy cleaver; disciplined planted stance
units.attack_description: Brace or step forward, lift cleaver/blade, twist torso into a clear downward-forward slash on frame 4, follow through and recover. Keep blade held in the hand.
units.hint: 举方盾列阵，物理减伤22%；怕绕过盾面的法术。

units.name: 穿封投矛手
units.design: Imperial red tabard scout, long seal-tagged throwing spear and a quiver of folded spears, no shield
units.attack_description: Draw the throwing object back beside the head, rotate shoulders, extend the throwing arm decisively on frame 4. The held throwing object MUST disappear in frame 4 and 5, because the real engine spawns a separate projectile. Frame 6 reaches for the next object. No painted flying projectile.
units.hint: 投矛撕开封甲，3.5秒内目标受到的物理伤害提高18%。

units.hint: 隔着前排落印重砸，范围打断；长前摇可被控制。

units.name: 落印攻城台

units.attack_description: Bend knees and twist the torso, raise the distinctive implement in the correct hand grip, gather intent in frame 3, extend or sweep it decisively forward on frame 4 to release a real engine spell, recoil in frame 5, recover frame 6. Keep identity and equipment coherent; no painted flying effect.

units.hint: 炭弓命中持续燃烧，净化与压近可以反制。

units.name: 取火钩魂客
units.design: Charcoal-masked slim exile, a long hooked fire-curved blade and a small furnace carried at the waist
units.attack_description: Swing the hook or taut kite line back, step with a low knee bend, cast the hooked line forward on frame 4, visibly pull backwards on frame 5 and recover. No painted flying object.
units.hint: 只从已燃烧目标吸血，需要余火猎和喷签师铺火。

units.name: 陶灰投火炉
units.design: A squat orange clay-paper kiln on broad scorched wheels, a rear chimney and hinged bowl catapult, no cannon barrel
units.attack_description: Brace the distinctive sled or kiln, scoop or arm the hinged launching bowl, raise to high angle in frame 3, EMPTY launcher releases on frame 4, whole chassis recoils on frame 5, reload frame 6. The engine draws the separate shell.
units.hint: 投出余火壶点燃敌群，炉车前摇长且容易被绕后。

units.name: 灰风喷签师
units.design: Hunched charcoal-paper bellows operator with a giant folded leather bellows, soot mask and burning talisman hopper
units.attack_description: Bend knees and twist the torso, raise the distinctive implement in the correct hand grip, gather intent in frame 3, extend or sweep it decisively forward on frame 4 to release a real engine spell, recoil in frame 5, recover frame 6. Keep identity and equipment coherent; no painted flying effect.
units.hint: 近程三段灰风扫群，火线短，需要前排保住喷签口。

units.name: 裂火抱壶者
units.design: A frantic small ash-paper exile hugging a huge cracked glowing fire pot, stubby bare feet and scorched headband
units.attack_description: Bend knees and twist the torso, raise the distinctive implement in the correct hand grip, gather intent in frame 3, extend or sweep it decisively forward on frame 4 to release a real engine spell, recoil in frame 5, recover frame 6. Keep identity and equipment coherent; no painted flying effect.
units.hint: 抱壶突入，阵亡引爆敌方；不会误伤己方纸工。

units.name: 余烬运金纸工
units.design: Ash-paper miner in charcoal mask with a soot-black pick, patched pot backpack and torn orange wrap.
units.attack_description: Real planted-foot pickaxe cycle, frame 4 strikes.
units.hint: 矿口采金，实际归仓入账；非战斗单位。

units.name: 空框映界卫
units.design: An eerie ivory faceless guard with an empty rectangular frame shield, a hole cut through the torso and thin violet seams
units.attack_description: Bend knees and twist the torso, raise the distinctive implement in the correct hand grip, gather intent in frame 3, extend or sweep it decisively forward on frame 4 to release a real engine spell, recoil in frame 5, recover frame 6. Keep identity and equipment coherent; no painted flying effect.
units.hint: 每5秒抹去一次敌方法术伤害，物理攻击穿透空框。

units.name: 镂字连签弩
units.design: White masked scribe with a punched-letter mechanical crossbow, floating cutout letters and a long perforated coat
units.attack_description: Raise and aim the distinctive crossbow or nail gun using BOTH hands, brace on frame 3, trigger release on frame 4 with a small muzzle recoil and EMPTY bolt rail, step back on frame 5, then open or reload the mechanism. Do not paint flying bolts.
units.hint: 首发删去敌人护符与强化再三连击，自己非常怕近战。

units.name: 删行执笔人
units.design: Very tall faceless ivory paper editor, huge thin eraser-quill staff and a rectangular blank page instead of face
units.attack_description: Bend knees and twist the torso, raise the distinctive implement in the correct hand grip, gather intent in frame 3, extend or sweep it decisively forward on frame 4 to release a real engine spell, recoil in frame 5, recover frame 6. Keep identity and equipment coherent; no painted flying effect.
units.hint: 删行法术封口，击杀真实敌兵返法，无法从召唤物刷取。

units.name: 页界折兽
units.design: Enormous horizontal ivory origami fox-dragon, four angular folded legs, long blank paper muzzle and layered fan tail; NOT humanoid golem
units.attack_description: The four-legged paper beast opens its muzzle and spreads layered neck pages in anticipation, lunges head and breathes forward on frame 4, neck and back curve, then folds pages and recovers. Never turn a standing humanoid around a pivot.
units.hint: 折兽展开页界喷息，抗法术却怕物理围攻。

units.name: 留白消矢师
units.design: Floating ivory folded-book spirit inside a white circular paper aperture, small faceless head and a fan eraser
units.attack_description: Bend knees and twist the torso, raise the distinctive implement in the correct hand grip, gather intent in frame 3, extend or sweep it decisively forward on frame 4 to release a real engine spell, recoil in frame 5, recover frame 6. Keep identity and equipment coherent; no painted flying effect.
units.hint: 周期抹除附近敌方飞弹，不消除直伤法术，沉默可封住。

units.name: 覆写禁印官
units.design: Ivory archivist carrying an oversized delete-stamp cylinder and a black-violet narrow ledger, rigid vertical long coat
units.attack_description: Bend knees and twist the torso, raise the distinctive implement in the correct hand grip, gather intent in frame 3, extend or sweep it decisively forward on frame 4 to release a real engine spell, recoil in frame 5, recover frame 6. Keep identity and equipment coherent; no painted flying effect.
units.hint: 覆写印优先封锁支援兵，逼对方用前排掩护。

units.name: 留白运金纸工
units.design: Small faceless ivory folded-paper clerk with a rectangular empty-frame basket and a narrow erase-pick.
units.attack_description: Real planted-foot pickaxe cycle, frame 4 strikes.
units.hint: 矿口采金，实际归仓入账；非战斗单位。

units.name: 纸骨兵
units.design: A very small ragged old-paper skeleton with bone limbs and a broken blade, empty skull face and no cloth armor.
units.attack_description: Brace or step forward, lift cleaver/blade, twist torso into a clear downward-forward slash on frame 4, follow through and recover. Keep blade held in the hand.
units.hint: 有来源与寿命限制的召唤物，不能招募或复制。

units.name: 护符纸卫
units.design: A small turquoise folded talisman doll with a squared lamp belly, short arms, tiny paper spear and faceless blank mask.
units.attack_description: Brace or step forward, lift cleaver/blade, twist torso into a clear downward-forward slash on frame 4, follow through and recover. Keep blade held in the hand.
units.hint: 有来源与寿命限制的召唤物，不能招募或复制。
